primary_path.name: explicit_Yee_ESIRKEPOV_CUDA
primary_path.scheme: picmi.ExplicitEvolveScheme with Yee solver, Esirkepov deposition, dt equal to 0.9 times the multidimensional electromagnetic CFL limit

documented_unavailable_paths.name: theta_implicit_em
documented_unavailable_paths.reason: Pinned skill reference time-integration.md documents repeated CUDA error 700 inside current deposition for loaded 2D electromagnetic plasmas on this runtime; implicit is not a commissioned solver path for this campaign.

documented_unavailable_paths.name: hybrid_or_fluid_electron
documented_unavailable_paths.reason: Explicitly forbidden by operator campaign instruction; the physical model must remain fully kinetic for electrons and ions.

documented_unavailable_paths.name: imposed_reconnection_electric_field
documented_unavailable_paths.reason: Forbidden by the operator campaign instruction and by the self-consistent GEM-type reconnection required by the root hypothesis.

documented_unavailable_paths.name: cpu_warpx_for_simulation
documented_unavailable_paths.reason: The simulation instrument contract binds the CUDA/openPMD capability; CPU WarpX is not part of the simulation pipeline for this campaign.

retry_and_stopping_rule.retry_action: rerun the same exact capability argv unchanged once after a transient CUDA error 700 or GPU abort
retry_and_stopping_rule.stop_condition: stop after two failures of the same scientific command; do not change source or parameters to force a run
retry_and_stopping_rule.closure_rule: if fewer than 2 of the 3 paired seeds complete for either endpoint at either fidelity level, close the seed-ensemble claim as instrument_limited; if a complete fidelity group is missing, keep the primary decision only when a documented prose qualification states the fidelity-control component was not executed
retry_and_stopping_rule.cleanup: failed runs remain on disk for auditing; reruns replace only their exact output targets

energy_quality_gate: per-run combined field-plus-particle relative drift must have absolute value at most 2e-3 for the run to count toward the decisive ensemble (matches design_pin.json and analyze_ensemble.py ENERGY_GATE_ABS).
validation_basis: Operator anchor validation: the exact supplied argv completed 4623 explicit CUDA steps in 445.4 s, wrote 26 readable HDF5 openPMD states, passed 26/26 five-aspect checks, and conserved combined field-plus-particle energy to 4.70e-5 relative over t*Omega_ci=12.
Guided package reuse policy: supplied program, outputs, and audits are non-evidentiary context; this plan only fixes solver selection, retry, and closure rules for fresh evidence.
